name_zh: 加纳·夸梅·恩克鲁玛：泛非非洲统一与政变流亡
name_en: Ghana Kwame Nkrumah: Pan-African African Unity & Coup Exile
description_zh: 夸梅·恩克鲁玛 (1909-1972) 加纳首任总理/总统 (1957-1966)，撒哈拉以南非洲首个独立国家领袖，泛非主义推动非洲统一组织成立，沃尔特河大坝工业化，1966年政变流亡几内亚。
description_en: Kwame Nkrumah (1909-1972) Ghana first PM/President (1957-1966), Sub-Saharan Africa first independent nation leader, Pan-Africanism drove OAU founding, Volta Dam industrialization, 1966 coup exiled Guinea.
reason_zh: 恩克鲁玛代表非洲独立浪潮的总领袖，展示了泛非主义如何从解放工具转化为国家建构意识形态，其政变流亡折射非洲早期国家建构的脆弱性，工业化遗产与泛非梦想并存。
reason_en: Nkrumah represents African independence wave paramount leader, demonstrating how Pan-Africanism transformed from liberation tool into nation-building ideology, his coup exile reflecting African early state-building fragility, industrialization legacy and Pan-African dream coexist.
steps_zh: 研究恩克鲁玛早年林肯大学神学与宾大教育
分析1957年加纳独立与泛非主义非洲统一声言
探讨沃尔特河阿科松博大坝工业化愿景
评估1966年政变流亡几内亚与晚年著作
总结泛非非洲统一政变流亡对非洲一体化的奠基与悲剧
steps_en: Study Nkrumah early Lincoln University theology and UPenn education
Analyze 1957 Ghana independence and Pan-Africanism African unity voice
Explore Volta River Akosombo Dam industrialization vision
Evaluate 1966 coup exile Guinea and late writings
Summarize Pan-African African unity coup exile foundational and tragic for African integration
expected_zh: 理解泛非主义如何从独立运动升华为大陆一体化纲领，掌握工业化与政治统一双轮驱动非洲现代化逻辑，评估恩克鲁玛遗产对非盟与非洲大陆自由贸易区的历史渊源。
expected_en: Understand how Pan-Africanism elevated from independence movement to continental integration program, grasp industrialization and political unity dual-wheel driving African modernization logic, evaluate Nkrumah legacy historical roots for AU and AfCFTA.
case_zh: 1957 独立；1963 非盟；1966 政变；1972 逝世。泛非非洲统一政变流亡范式永存。
case_en: 1957 independence; 1963 OAU; 1966 coup; 1972 death. Pan-African African unity coup exile paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Pan-Africanism; African unity; industrialization; coup exile
